AMD FidelityFX SDK ffx-api headers, tag v2.3.0, MIT, in ffx_api_2.3.0/ in the SDK's
own layout (api/include, upscalers/include, framegeneration/include: they include
each other by those paths). Fetched 2026-09-24 from GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/
FidelityFX-SDK. Headers only. The helper compiles against them since the frame
generation revival's phase 1A (2026-09-24) and loads the runtime below through
ffx_api_loader.h, so the runtime can change without a rebuild. The upscale
descriptions are field for field the 1.1.4 ones; the one function that compiles
differently is AMD's inline ffxApiGetResourceDX12 (tools/fg-off-allowed.txt).
The loader header wants PLATFORM_WINDOWS defined (the helper defines it before it).

ffx_api/ holds the tag v1.1.4 (FSR 3.1.4) headers, fetched 2026-09-04, MIT,
compiled into nothing since 2026-09-24; kept because docs/POSTMORTEM-FRAME-
GENERATION.md and FSR-FRAMEGEN.md cite them. Removing the folder is a later tidy.

THE RUNTIME THAT SHIPS, since 1.0.4 (owner, 2026-09-21). Not committed
(*.dll is gitignored); package.ps1 pins each file by size, MD5 and AMD's
Authenticode signature and refuses to package anything else:

  amd_fidelityfx_loader_dx12.dll      39,184 bytes  08561837C75E2F9374E48B2320F473B2
  amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_dx12.dll  57,664,272 bytes  C9B73B38F9F2744C7096DE53429DB6EB
  amd_ags_x64.dll                    179,408 bytes  9352802FAE8E6FF020AFD9257F33AF23

The loader and the upscaler: AMD FSR SDK 2.4.0 (FSR 4.1.2) since 1.1, taken
unmodified from AMD's official minimal package v2.4.0.zip (254,235,565 bytes,
SHA-256 27120e3bbe0d0b30213825ad40f19077563f04f04572e252109a392d5fb522cb,
GitHub GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, tag v2.4.0, downloaded
2026-10-29 with the owner's approval), Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin. The upscaler's
file version is 4.1.2.4555: FSR 4.1.2 and FSR 3.1.6 by AMD's release notes. The
loader holds no effect code. AGS is the 2.3.0 file, the same bytes as the 2.4.0
package's Kits/OpenSource/amd/ags. All three Authenticode-valid, signed by
Advanced Micro Devices. 1.0.4 to 1.0.9 shipped the SDK 2.3.0 pair (loader 26,376
bytes DE911B016F4849D4DC7A358058C9E3CB, upscaler 28,761,864 bytes
429D308876434A1247F40BD543EFDDDB, FSR 4 and FSR 3.1.5). Their terms: AMD's
2.4.0 license.md, in LICENSE-AMD-FidelityFX-SDK.txt (PART 1) with the headers'
MIT text (PART 2). AGS is MIT: LICENSE-AMD-AGS.txt, from
GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/AGS_SDK.

THE FRAME GENERATION LIBRARY, same folder of the same archive, extracted 2026-09-24
with the owner's approval. NOT PACKAGED, AND NO SHIPPED HELPER LOADS IT (2026-10-25):
a shipped helper runs frame generation on the mod's own library, dlssiv-fg.dll,
which this project builds from this SDK's public source (build-ffx-own.ps1 -Target
dlssiv-fg, from ffx_api_2.3.0/ here, every file of it MIT by AMD's license.md),
held to tools/ffx-own/RECORD-dlssiv-fg-cut.txt; package.ps1 -Ship packages that
library and must not pin this one (tools/ffx_pin.py refuses a pin there). This
file stays for the development helper's AMD twin (the kit's twin legs) and the desk
tools that stage it, by the pin below (tools/ffx_pin.py):

  amd_fidelityfx_framegeneration_dx12.dll  40,085,776 bytes  6A12BC4DC82AE11E81C37930B439F6C9

Authenticode-valid, Advanced Micro Devices. What phase 1A measured of it (DECISIONS
2026-09-24 "PHASE 1A"): it offers one frame generation provider, "3.1.6" (id
0xF600000000C01006) on the 4090 and embeds two more names, "3.1.7" (the frame
interpolation swapchain, not used) and "4.0.1" (the ML frame generation, with FP8
kernels: offered on RDNA 4 by the evidence, hidden here as FSR 4 upscaling is); the
create accepts the 0x0e version description (FFX_FRAMEGENERATION_VERSION 4.0.1) and
phase 2 links it; it needs neither amd_acs_x64.dll nor amd_ags_x64.dll; it imports
timeBeginPeriod, timeEndPeriod and timeGetDevCaps from WINMM but never calls
timeBeginPeriod headless; a context is 487 MiB at 4K FP16 (207 aliasable) and
214 MiB at 1440p 8-bit (97 aliasable) by its own figure; it creates in about 0.4 s
on a cold driver shader cache and in 35 to 45 ms warm.

amd_fidelityfx_dx12.dll (SDK 1.1.4's monolithic library, FSR 3.1.4, 6,675,664
bytes, MD5 49230AD94ED6169933CD0457501D9CB4) shipped from 1.0 to 1.0.3 and is
NOT packaged from 1.0.4 (owner, 2026-09-21: "people will report if they have
issues, then we can reintroduce it as a fallback"). The helper still loads it
when the loader is absent, so bringing it back is a package.ps1 change only.

ffx_api/ffx_framegeneration.h (1.1.4) was added 2026-09-06 and compiled into nothing
after the removal of 2026-09-09 (docs/POSTMORTEM-FRAME-GENERATION.md). The 2.3.0
ffx_framegeneration.h IS compiled into the helper since 2026-09-24: host/fg_smoke.h in
development builds (--fgsmoke=N), the production context from the revival's phase 2.
Frame generation is a separate effect from upscaling with its own context, so it
needs no new entry points: ffxLoadFunctions resolves the same five.
